crossRefs.note: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much…

translations.web: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
translations.bsb: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
translations.kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
translations.asv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
